relevance_note: Multicentre Indian SAID cohort whose Table 3 lists four patients under 'A20 haploinsufficiency (TNFAIP3) (n=4)' (Pt. 40-43) with individual TNFAIP3 variants, e.g. 'c.1504C>T; p.Arg502Trp Heterozygous missense'.
method_note: Hand extraction; a short Python script in scratch only assembled the JSON and checked spans verbatim. Scope: the four TNFAIP3 carriers in Table 3 (rows 'Pt. 40'-'Pt. 43', listed under the A20 haploinsufficiency heading) plus two relatives of Pt. 40 (mother, carrier; younger brother, affected with recurrent oral ulcers, tested negative: 'the younger sibling does not carry this variant', so he has no variant row). All other cohort members (other genes) get no rows. Labels: Pt. 40 is printed as 'Patient no 40' 3 times (Figure 7 legend), 'Pt. 40' once and 'Patient 40' once, so the most frequent form 'Patient no 40' is used; Pt. 41 ties 'Pt. 41'/'Patient 41' and the table form was chosen, as for Pt. 42 and Pt. 43 (table only). Cohort size: 107 patients collated, 78 retained ('Remaining 78 patients'); the Discussion also gives '(8/49)' for deaths; 78 recorded. Ethnicity/country 'India' comes from the cohort-level statement that patients are from India, not a per-person statement. Pt. 42 and Pt. 43 variants are labelled VUS by the authors yet grouped under the HA20 heading; disease label taken from that heading. Pt. 40 age at onset in Table 3 is '6 M' while the text says she presented with oral/genital ulcers at 2 years; both recorded (individual onset 6 M, ulcer onset 2 years); not treated as a contradiction. Pt. 40 'Initial diagnosis' was Behcet disease. HLA-B51 positivity for Pt. 40 not recorded as a phenotype. 'ANA, ANCA: negative' recorded as excluded positive ANA and ANCA, but the composite checklist item 'autoantibodies (ANA/other)' left not reported (narrow vs broad). 'Gut Biopsy: no vasculitis' recorded as a feature row only; checklist vasculitis left not reported. Pt. 42 positive direct Coombs test recorded as a feature; checklist autoantibodies left not reported. Pt. 43 'Osteomyelitis/CGD' recorded as stated; recurrent infections left not reported. CNS involvement for Pt. 40 marked observed from papilledema and brain MRI showing type 2 Arnold Chiari malformation (interpretive). 'Novel' in the text for Pt. 40 is not treated as a pathogenicity classification. Variant type not derived from HGVS for Pt. 41-43. Columns marked 'NA' treated as not reported. No stacked ' / ' cells involved. Pt. 40 is called 'the index patent' [sic].
